name: Elephant Robotics
summary: Elephant Robotics is a Shenzhen robotics company founded in 2016. It develops and manufactures collaborative robot arms, mobile platforms, humanoid robots and robotic companion animals, alongside control software and education tools. Its Mercury humanoid family serves research, education and commercial development, complementing its myCobot, myArm and myAGV product lines.
